name: 10'x20'~ Custom Food Booth Canopy Tent Package-HEX Aluminum Frame, Full Back Wall & 3 Half Side Walls with Half Mesh with Windows.
descriptionHtml:
Custom Food Booth Canopy Tent Package 10x20

Make your food stand unforgettable with our premium 10x20 Custom Canopy Tent Package, designed especially for food vendors, farmers’ markets, and outdoor events. This compact, professional-grade canopy combinesdurability, ventilation, and full customizationto help your booth stand out from the crowd.

Key Features:

🏕️ Product Size: 120" W x 137" H x 240" D – spacious 10x20 setup for large vendor areas.

💪 Durable Frame: Heavy-duty aluminum frame with ABS nylon hardware for strength and stability.

🎨 Custom Printing: Full-color dye-sublimation printing on canopy top and walls for vibrant, fade-resistant graphics.

🧱 Half Side Walls with Mesh: Solid fabric bottoms with mesh tops for airflow and visibility.

🪟 Front Wall with Two Serving Windows: Efficient design for food service and customer interaction.

🚪 Left Wall with Window & Zippered Doorway: Easy access plus ventilation.

🧵 Full Fabric Back Wall: Printed inward for professional interior appearance.

🔁 Double-Sided Printing Upgrade: Optional for maximum brand exposure on all walls.

☀️ Weather-Resistant Canopy: Made of 600 Denier Polyester, UV-protected and waterproof.

⚙️ Quick Pop-Up Design: Tool-free assembly for fast setup.

🧳 Wheeled Carry Bag Included: Convenient transport and storage for the frame.

🎁 Complete Package: Frame, canopy top, printed walls, wheeled carry bag, free design service, and fast delivery.

Optional Accessories:

6' Table Cover

Feather Flags

Sandbags

Materials:

Hardware: ABS Nylon, Aluminum

Canopy: 600 Denier Polyester

Certifications:

Meets FR Rating Requirements

Primary Usage:

Outdoor events, food festivals, farmers’ markets, trade shows, and pop-up shops

Factory Warranty

  • We stand behind the quality of our products. Our warranty covers any factory defects or damage that occurs during shipping. However, please note that we do not cover damage resulting from extreme weather conditions, misuse, or any circumstances beyond our control.
